reason: Both correctly identify the same four core defects (LEFT JOIN turned into INNER JOIN via WHERE, UTC/UTC+8 offset, NULL total_spent, integer division truncation) with equivalent accuracy, but Response B additionally flags the non-aggregated SELECT columns missing from GROUP BY as a real portability/strict-SQL-mode defect, correctly caveating that it works under Postgres due to functional dependency on the primary key, adding legitimate value that Response A only mentions as an aside while explicitly declining to call it a defect.
